name: memento
description: Multi-layer cache memory base. L3 (sources) -> L2 (wiki) -> L1 (AGENTS.md) compilation pipeline with a deterministic eval gate (compile auto-rolls-back if a load-bearing fact drops from the always-resident hot set), health checks, passive session capture (save), active LLM-driven interview (ama), and lightweight follow-up queue review (followups). Knowledge base only — commitments belong in the user's issue tracker.

interface.longDescription: Multi-layer local memory base. Six skills cover the full loop: memento-config (setup + ongoing config), health-check (read-only doctor + the eval gate's golden-query scorer), save (passive session capture), ama (active LLM-driven interview), compile (sources -> wiki -> AGENTS.md hot set, gated by a deterministic eval + auto-rollback that protects the hot set before commit), and followups (lightweight follow-up queue review — expired-first). Knowledge base only; real commitments belong in the user's issue tracker. Supports a configurable Memento data root for global plugin installs.
defaultPrompt: Set up a memory base in this repo.
Run a health check on my memory base.
Compile my sources into the wiki.
Save this session and capture useful context.
Ask me anything to fill in gaps in my wiki.
